name: io.github.pgg898200-ship-it/cloture
description: Zero-dependency Rust statistical engine for anytime-valid multi-agent consensus stopping, correlated judge-panel n_eff auditing, sequential agent racing, Active-PPI++, and poisoning-resistant fusion.

tools.name: cloture_mode_stop
tools.description: Anytime-valid multi-agent consensus stopping (grey-box ASC-D over probability vectors or category-agnostic unbounded CITE over labels).

tools.name: cloture_audit_panel
tools.description: Audit an LLM-as-a-judge or multi-agent panel for correlated error collapse (Kish & eigenvalue n_eff, Condorcet gap, permutation p-value, LOO redundant-judge pruning).

tools.name: cloture_population_cert
tools.description: Unit-level population superiority certification across prompts under correlated rollouts with optimal rollouts-per-prompt allocation.

tools.name: cloture_agent_race
tools.description: Sequential anytime-valid multi-arm agent/model racing with FWER control and Wang-Ramdas e-BH FDR discoveries.

tools.name: cloture_active_ppi
tools.description: Anytime-valid Active Prediction-Powered Inference (Active-PPI++) combining cheap LLM judge scores with sparse human audits.

tools.name: cloture_safe_fuse
tools.description: Poisoning-resistant multi-agent online aggregation (Scale-Free BOA + Fan-inequality Ville e-process quarantine).
